instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the past progressive.

Das past progressive wird für vorübergehende Handlungen zu einem bestimmten Zeitpunkt in der Vergangenheit verwendet. Achte auf die markierten Signalwörter.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the past progressive.

atoms.b: <u>While</u> the students ((were_participating)) in my seminar, someone stole their bikes.
<u>During</u> the last summer holidays, I ((was_reading)) a book about moving abroad.
My dad ((was_cooking)) a lasagne <u>for hours</u> last Sunday.

instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the present progressive.

Das past progressive wird verwendet, wenn eine Handlung oder ein Vorgang in der Vergangenheit durch eine andere Handlung unterbrochen wurde.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the present progressive.

atoms.b: <u>While</u> you ((were_reading)) an article, the alarm went off.
They ((were_discussing)) their results <u>when</u> the teacher arrived.

instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the past progressive.

Das past progressive wird genutzt, wenn zwei Handlungen zeitgleich stattgefunden haben.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the past progressive.

atoms.b: She ((was_writing)) an article <u>while</u> her friend was editing the video.
<u>While</u> we ((were_cleaning_up)) the beach, others were taking photos.

instruction.text:
Insert the correct verb in the past progressive.

Das past progressive wird genutzt, wenn ein Vorgang oder eine Handlung zeitlich begrenzt war.
instruction.sound: Insert the correct verb in the past progressive.

atoms.b: For a few years they ((were_studying)) environmental law in Berlin.
At that time she ((was_volunteering)) at a local dog shelter.
